bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the project workflow and wrote regression tests with pytest for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Cleaned supplied product metadata tables in pandas using provided steps, then plotted record counts with Matplotlib and inspected missing-value summaries with guidance.
Within a supervised research team, wrote Python functions for parsing provided research abstract records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.

Under supervision, joined document identifiers to bibliographic metadata using pandas merges, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons with Matplotlib, and documented missing-data handling.
